title: 第2272章 以身合道第2271章 就在今天
lines: 十几颗陨石状态的事物，虽然是横跨空间通道才出现在太阳系，但苏恒的实力想要寻本追源不难。
一座小千世界内纯粹的创世之力激荡而出，在这些陨石上冲刷了一下，他就开启一个空间门，带着天仙级路天行一起跨出了步伐。
路天行现在是天仙，不过他曾经的麾下，还有好几个金仙以及一位大罗存在，上次去仙域时，他即便在仙域陨落两年多了，但身为主宰一方十几万年的仙帝，短短两年多还不至于让所有手下都被屠杀干净。
击杀他的仙帝，也不是毫发无伤。
这多少也算有点能装点门面的实力了。
大罗对应的可是苏恒所在体系里的上位神。
等他们到了新时空，苏恒洒出感知后，才玩味道，“没想到这个掀起入侵地球大潮的幕后黑手这么弱。”
这片时空依旧现代位面银河系内，以苏恒的时空大道造诣去推断，位置距离地球也就是几千光年外。
前方虚空中悬立的巨大生命星球，在两颗恒星环卫下，几乎不存在黑夜一词，这个星球，霸主族群是一个自称为天演族的族群，此外还有好几种附庸族群。
走的是个体超凡加科技并行的道路。
整个天演族最强的存在，才6阶湮灭境，连神明或者说仙人都远远称不上，这最强的存在拉去地球，已经晋升为五阶灾变境的几个主角联手都未必不能打败对方。
天演族本身，才飞速崛起不久，依靠的就是星空探索时的意外发现。
他们的个体超凡武力，科技等等，在百年前都很弱，最强只有四阶星主，短距离太空旅行的能力。
就是探索中，意外发现了一个巨大的宝藏，那些宝藏就是类似苏生手中掌握的充满生机的陨石状物质，这些玩意，类似于创世之力一样，你得到后普通强者就可以编辑设定下条件，开始有偏差的造物。
比如抓着一颗陨石状物质，脑海中臆想创造出不知疲倦不畏生死源源不断还听从命令的生物兵器军团，那就可以造出来一批不知疲倦不畏生死源源不断……白痴一样只知道杀戮的军团怪物。
第一波入侵地球的，就是这样的生物军团。
怪不得方流衣记忆中，第一波入侵者并不是不能抵抗，其最大特征是源源不绝几乎无穷尽的怪物数量。
天演族靠着得到一条小行星带似的陨石状物质，至少数十万颗，短短百年就靠着各种研究探索，让天演星飞一般增强壮大。
不只是武力上从最强只有星主境，爆发到了出现湮灭境强者，科技侧也是连级跳，这陨石状物质，你抓到后用于制造科技设备时，脑海中想要制造出轻松横跨几十几百光年来往的空间运输装备，都有概率成功制造出来。
这些蕴含无穷生机的陨石状物资，就像是苏恒的创世之力，可以演化一切，演化万物。
苏恒身为神王，有着庞大的实力支撑，想要创造什么都是完美具现，天演族得到那几十万颗陨石状物资，虽然本能强大，御使他们的天演族强者，实力却太低。
总是会在各式各样的创造中，出现偏差。
就算如此，百年时间，天演族纵横星空，向着一方宇宙霸主地位冲刺的效率，也是大大加快了。
他们派第一波入侵者去侵入地球，不是真的要屠尽地球生灵掌控一颗灵气低迷的星球，还是想驯服地球人，想让地球人像他们收下的其他小弟一样，成为手下先锋军之一。
要不然在方流衣重生之前那个域外文明入侵时代，第一批降临者里出现几个神通境，星主境，就能灭掉全球了。
天演族横扫宇宙，惯例是先观察一下目标大致情况，根据详情派遣不同等级的生物兵器军团，打一打看一看，若目标不值一提被摧枯拉朽覆灭，就灭掉。
若目标有价值，使用性，再在边打边培养中，努力去收服对方、这就是为什么方流衣重生前，面对不同族群的入侵者，不同档次的入侵者，人族还能出现球奸这个物种。
人族在长达二十多年的自保反击战，从最初只有不入流的国术大师，一口气飙升到诞生出四阶星主境，哪怕这里面也有陨石状物资诞生出无穷灵气，改善了地球环境的关键因素。
还有天演族带着球奸去研究适合人族功法的基础，但短短二十多年，就从不入流诞生星主，这巨大的潜力，早就被天演族盯上了，觉得人族已经是他们收下的小弟族群里，天赋最高档次之一，才给了地球人不少机会。
否则方流衣重生那时间，随便蹦出来一个灾变境都能全灭地球，别说湮灭惊和各种不可思议的连级跳科技侧武器了。
而整个过程，全人类从近百亿被屠杀的只剩下不足十亿？这个天演族根本不会去理会，他们只相信，靠自身实力可以镇压一切不服。
在苏恒情绪复杂时，路天行这个天仙都忍不住惊叹道，“不可思议，这是比我们仙域里长生物质更恐怖的创世物质，竟然能被普通三四阶强者去尝试掌控、使用？？”
他也是天仙了，比肩八阶的实力还有长生之能。
在仙域，他身为一方仙帝都不可能掌控创世之力，只有以身合世界，成为天道级主宰才行。
地球现代位面几千光年之外，竟然有一群才走出太空的初级文明，获得了那么多，实力那么低微都可以尝试去掌控的创世物质？？
这一刻路天行哪怕曾是统御仙域一方十几万年的仙帝，都忍不住起了巨大的抢夺之心。
苏恒则是放出感知，时间、空间大道不断交错着去推演感知庞大的银河系，几十个呼吸后，他也凝声道，“我或许明白那一条小行星带蕴含的陨石状物质，是什么了。”
“或许是这个位面，银河系演化之初，意外被什么因素打断了，终止了，所以原本应该诞生无数昌盛修炼文明星球的星核，就这样化为小行星带游荡在银河系。”
“它们是有机会演化出一个个创世指数上万度的星球的，可惜全被打断了，处于半演化状态。”
所以，苏恒崛起的银河系位面，哪怕经历过星河联邦和吞星族大战，战后十几年就崛起了起源星无数超凡族群和文明。
但这个银河系，几乎全是灵力不存，或者灵气极度稀薄的星球和文明，就是扩张中的天演族，其基础环境创世指数，只是和苏恒刚重生时的大明崇祯年差不多，最强只能容纳星主。
“我若拿下这批宝贝，就可以有机会像是道友合身仙域一样，成为一方天道，不过我合的会是目前的银河系。”
content_en:
Although more than a dozen meteorite-like things appeared in the solar system only after crossing a space channel, it is not difficult to trace the source of Su Heng's strength.
The pure power of creation surged out of a small thousand world. After washing over these meteorites, he opened a space door and stepped out with the immortal-level Lu Tianxing.
Lu Tianxing is now a Celestial Immortal, but he once had several Golden Immortals and a Da Luo under his command. The last time he went to the Immortal Realm, even though he had fallen in the Immortal Realm for more than two years, as an Immortal Emperor who had dominated the side for hundreds of thousands of years, he would not have all his subordinates slaughtered in just over two years.
The Immortal Emperor who killed him was not unscathed.
This is somewhat of a facade-dressing ability.
Da Luo corresponds to the higher god in Su Heng's system.
When they arrived in the new time and space, Su Heng revealed his senses and then said, "I didn't expect the mastermind behind the invasion of the earth to be so weak."
This space and time is still in the modern plane of the Milky Way. Judging from Su Heng's knowledge of the time and space avenue, the location is thousands of light years away from the earth.
The huge living planet hanging in the void in front is surrounded by two stars, and the word "night" almost does not exist. On this planet, the overlord group is a group that calls itself the Tianyan tribe, and there are also several vassal groups.
It is a path that combines personal transcendence and technology.
The strongest being in the entire Tianyan clan is only in the 6th level of annihilation state. He is far from being called a god or immortal. If this strongest being pulls the earth, several protagonists who have been promoted to the 5th level of catastrophic state may not be able to defeat each other if they join forces.
The Tianyan clan itself has only recently risen rapidly, relying on unexpected discoveries during starry sky exploration.
Their individual extraordinary strength, technology, etc. were all weak a hundred years ago. The strongest were only fourth-order star masters with the ability to travel short distances in space.
During the exploration, I accidentally discovered a huge treasure. Those treasures are similar to the vital meteorite-like substances in Su Sheng's hands. These things are similar to the power of creation. After you get them, ordinary strong people can edit and set conditions to start deviated creations.
For example, if you grab a meteorite-like substance and imagine in your mind that you can create a legion of biological weapons that are tireless and fearless of life and death, and yet obey orders, you can create a legion of monsters that are tireless, fearless of life and death, and are endless...like idiots who only know how to kill.
The first wave of invasion of the earth was this kind of biological army.
No wonder Fang Liuyi remembered that the first wave of invaders was not irresistible. Its biggest feature was the endless and almost endless number of monsters.
The Tianyan clan relied on obtaining a meteorite-like material like an asteroid belt, at least hundreds of thousands of them. In just a few hundred years, they relied on various research and exploration to make Tianyan become stronger and stronger like stars.
Not only is the strength from the strongest in the Star Lord Realm to the emergence of the strongest in the Annihilation Realm, but the technology side is also jumping up and down. When you catch this meteorite-like material and use it to make technological equipment, if you want to create space transportation equipment that can easily travel across dozens of hundreds of light years, there is a probability of successfully manufacturing it.
These meteorite-like materials containing infinite vitality are like Su Heng's power of creation, capable of evolving everything and all things.
As a god king, Su Heng has huge strength support, and everything he wants to create can be perfectly realized. The Tianyan tribe obtained hundreds of thousands of meteorite-like materials. Although their instincts are strong, the strength of the Tianyan tribe strongman who controls them is too low.
Deviations will always occur in all kinds of creations.
Even so, in a hundred years, the Tianyan clan's efficiency in sprinting across the starry sky and towards the hegemony of the universe has been greatly accelerated.
They sent the first wave of invaders to invade the earth, not because they really wanted to kill all the earth's creatures and control a planet with low spiritual energy, but they also wanted to tame the earth's people, and wanted the earth's people to become one of their vanguards like the other younger brothers they had accepted.
Otherwise, in the era of invasion by extraterrestrial civilizations before Fang Liuyi was reborn, if a few supernatural powers and star masters appeared among the first batch of descendants, the whole world would have been wiped out.
The Tianyan clan is sweeping across the universe. The usual practice is to first observe the general situation of the target, and then dispatch biological weapon legions of different levels according to the details. They will fight and take a look. If the target is not worth mentioning and is destroyed, then destroy it.
If the target is valuable and usable, then strive to conquer the opponent while fighting and training. This is why before Fang Liuyi was reborn, facing invaders of different ethnic groups and different levels, the human race could still have the species of rapist.
In the self-protection counterattack that lasted for more than 20 years, the human race went from having only low-level martial arts masters at the beginning to giving birth to the fourth-level star master realm in one breath. Even though there were meteorite-like materials in it, infinite spiritual energy was born, which was a key factor in improving the earth's environment.
There are also Tianyan tribesmen who have brought prostitutes to study the basics of martial arts that are suitable for the human race. However, in just over twenty years, Star Masters have been born from an unknown source. This huge potential has long been targeted by the Tianyan tribe. They feel that the human race is already one of the highest-level talents among the younger tribes they have accepted, so they have given many opportunities to the people on earth.
Otherwise, at the time of Fang Liuyi's rebirth, any catastrophic realm that pops up can completely wipe out the earth, let alone the annihilation shock and various incredible continuous-level jumping technology side weapons.
And during the entire process, the entire human race was slaughtered from nearly 10 billion to less than a billion? This Tianyan tribe will not pay attention to it at all. They only believe that they can suppress all dissatisfaction with their own strength.
When Su Heng's emotions were complicated, Lu Tianxing, an immortal, couldn't help but exclaimed, "It's unbelievable. This is a creation material that is more terrifying than the immortality material in our fairyland. It can actually be controlled and used by ordinary third- and fourth-level powerhouses??"
He is also an immortal, with strength comparable to the eighth level and the ability to live forever.
In the Immortal Realm, even as an Immortal Emperor, he could not control the power of creation. He could only combine his body with the world and become a Heavenly Dao-level ruler.
Thousands of light years away from the modern plane of the earth, there is actually a group of elementary civilizations that have just stepped out of space. They have obtained so much creation material that even with such low strength can try to control it? ?
At this moment, even though Lu Tianxing had been the Immortal Emperor who had ruled the Immortal Realm for hundreds of thousands of years, he couldn't help but have a huge desire to snatch it.
Su Heng released his perception, and the avenues of time and space were constantly intertwined to deduce the vast galaxy. After dozens of breaths, he also said in a serious voice, "I may understand what the meteorite-like material contained in that asteroid belt is."
"Perhaps this plane, at the beginning of the evolution of the Milky Way, was accidentally interrupted by some factor and terminated. Therefore, the star core that was supposed to give birth to countless prosperous and cultivating civilization planets turned into an asteroid belt and wandered around the Milky Way."
"They had the opportunity to evolve into planets with creation indexes of tens of thousands of degrees. Unfortunately, they were all interrupted and are in a semi-evolutionary state."
Therefore, the galactic plane where Su Heng emerged, even though it experienced the war between the Galaxy Federation and the Galactus Tribe, countless extraordinary groups and civilizations emerged in the Origin Star within a dozen years after the war.
But this galaxy is almost entirely populated by planets and civilizations that have no spiritual energy or extremely thin spiritual energy, which is the expanding Tianyan clan. Its basic environmental creation index is only about the same as that of the Chongzhen year of the Ming Dynasty when Su Henggang was reborn. The strongest can only accommodate star masters.
"If I win this batch of treasures, I will have the opportunity to become a Heavenly Dao just like a fellow Taoist merging into the Immortal Realm, but I will be merging with the current Milky Way."
